headline: Thinking Machines is introducing Inkling 2 Small, its second model generation
body: Thinking Machines is introducing Inkling 2 Small, a mixture-of-experts model with 594B total parameters and 17B active. Thinking Machines says Inkling 2 Small far surpasses its previous models on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and it intends to make the full weights available under an Apache 2.0 license next week. The Decoder says the better results come partly at the cost of higher token usage.
note: For banks and insurers weighing open models, the question to test is how much extra token use a gain costs.

evidence.text: Today we are introducing our second model generation with Inkling 2 Small.
It is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total parameters, 17B active, and supports image inputs and variable effort.

Inkling 2 Small far surpasses our previous models’ scores on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 31, reflecting gains in performance on agentic coding, vision, knowledge work, and reasoning.
We intend to make the full weights available under an Apache 2.0 license next week after the completion of external safety testing and red-teaming.

Thinking Machines, the startup from former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, is releasing Inkling 2 Small, a mixture-of-experts model with 594 billion parameters, 17 billion of which are active at any given time.
The better results come partly at the cost of higher token usage.
